# Security

This is a public repository with a single maintainer. If you find a security
vulnerability, please use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability)
(the "Report a vulnerability" button under this repo's Security tab) rather
than filing a public issue.

There is no SLA on response time and no dedicated security contact address —
reports go to the maintainer directly through GitHub.
